headlines.title: Are Flu and Cold Symptoms Worse for Men or Women?
headlines.description: There may actually be some biological truth to the so-called “man cold.” NBC medical contributors Dr. Natalie Azar and Dr. Akshay Syal join TODAY to break down how men and women may experience virus symptoms differently and share common treatments that work for everyone.

headlines.title: Brooke Eby, Who Chronicled Life With ALS on TikTok, Dies at 37
headlines.description: Brooke Eby, a TikTok star who documented her battle with ALS with courage, openness and humor, has died at the age of 37. Eby, who received the diagnosis just four years ago, posted videos on social media, determined to share every aspect of her journey.
